Catch block silently swallows DELETE error without logging or propagating; cleanup failure is unobserved.
Automation marked 'unscheduled' lacks required TODO(handoff) marker; open end documented in comment but not properly flagged per SDLC contract.
catch block silently swallows listAttachments() errors without user feedback, masking failures in a data-loading function
Tags update fetch response not checked; silent failure if server returns error status
Status update fetch in cancelInstead not checked; unhandled error on critical delete operation
TagDot is exported but not imported or used anywhere in the diff.
c.tag_ids is spread without null check; if undefined, throws at runtime. Should use ...(c.tag_ids ?? []).
b.startTime passed to fmtBooking() without null check; if undefined, fmtBooking().toLocaleString() fails at runtime.
